questions.q: Identify the clause type: “The nurse who attended me was very kind.”
questions.why: 'Who attended me' describes the noun 'nurse'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “Take an umbrella in case it ____ this evening.”
questions.why: 'In case' is followed by the present simple for future time. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive construction: “People believe him to be dishonest.”
opts: He is believed to be dishonest.
questions.why: Present 'believe' becomes 'is believed', infinitive kept. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: “Able to use both hands equally well”
questions.why: Ambidextrous means equally skilled with the right and left hand. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “ameliorate”:
questions.why: Ameliorate = make better. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “placate”:
questions.why: To placate is to calm or appease someone. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct version: “He insisted to go there alone.”
opts: He insisted on going there alone.
He insisted to going there alone.
He insisted for go there alone.
He insisted on to go there alone.
questions.why: 'Insist on' is followed by a gerund. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “pernicious”:
questions.why: 'Pernicious' means having a gradual, destructive effect; harmful. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “reticent”:
questions.why: 'Reticent' means unwilling to speak freely; reserved. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct inversion of: “If you need any help, please call me.”
opts: Would you need any help, please call me.
Should you need any help, please call me.
Shall you need any help, please call me.
Were you need any help, please call me.
questions.why: First-conditional inversion uses 'Should + subject + base verb'. GPSC-style practice item.
